verdict.rationale: Persona's own Workflows feature automates repetitive manual decisions. Workflows start from triggers and can automatically tag high-risk inquiries or run additional reports when conditions are met. Reports can also be configured to run at regular intervals (e.g., monthly Watchlist re-screening), so automations cover both event-triggered and recurring runs without manual intervention. Missing for 10: detail on the available trigger types and workflow step capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence of AI- or agent-driven autonomous behavior beyond rule-based automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: You can use them to automate repetitive manual decisions and decrease manual review time.
you can create a workflow to automatically tag high-risk inquiries, run additional reports when specific conditions are met, or ingest non-Persona, 3rd party data.
All workflows begin with a trigger, which initiates the workflow.
Reports can be configured to run in regular intervals against an account. For example, you can run a Watchlist Report against your accounts each month or once a year.
